provenance: Hand-transcribed from the three targeted tests. Each places one note and changes exactly one setting, leaving the rest at their defaults. The changed setting is hardware-confirmed; the untouched fields are transcribed from the file, corroborated by the two empty baselines.

defaults.comment: What a freshly placed note looks like when nothing is edited.

patterns.comment: Test 1 -- gate on a drum track. Single kick at beat 1, gate raised to 4, everything else default.
Test 2 -- step skip on a drum track. Single kick at beat 1, set to play only in sequence 32. Confirms the drum skip parameter is note-indexed and that a single-sequence mask is bit 1 alone.
Test 3 -- gate on a melodic track, for comparison with test 1. C3 at beat 1, gate 4. Pitch 60 displaying as C3 is what fixes the octave convention.
